positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Applied deep learning to natural language processing tasks
• Developed a neural network model using word- and character-level bidirectional LSTMs, achieving the state-of-the-art performance for de-identification of patient notes, without the need to use manual features
• Devised neural network models using LSTMs and CNNs for sequential classification of short texts,
demonstrating the improved performance on dialog act prediction task
• Won the Dialog State Tracking Challenge 2015, organized by A*STAR, Microsoft Research, and Google

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Taught analytical and computational fundamentals of inference and machine learning
• Building on the foundations of probabilistic modeling and analysis, covered diverse topics in probabilistic inference including graphical models such as HMMs, and sampling techniques such as MCMC

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Established the existence of competitive equilibria in combinatorial auctions for unimodular demand types via linear programming, simplifying the proof based on tropical geometry in the literature
• Developed a paradigm for associating two different representations (graphical valuations and demand types) of complementarity/substitutability among multiple items

positions.title: Field Services Systems Engineer
positions.description:
• Conducted data analysis for pinpointing the root cause of failures, and suggested possible hardware and software improvements to lower the failure rate
• Successfully managed the project for the certification of a 5kW fuel cell system for the first time in Korea
• Trained field service technicians on the operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of fuel cell units

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Researched applying control theory to microeconomics for senior thesis
• Developed a mathematical model for a simple microeconomic system of hunter-gather society
• Implemented and tested the model, proving useful insights

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
• Assisted in organizing a laboratory class on embedded microprocessor system design 
• Designed, built, programmed, and debugged an MP3 player based on a Motorola DSP chip
• Taught hardware and software skills for microprocessor system design, including interfacing with I/O devices and programming in both high-level (C) and low-level (assembly) languages
